search_summary: 增量更新 2026-06-23 至 2026-07-13，新增 22 个数据集 + 1 个版本更新。重点发现：GaoYao (ACL 2026 Main, 26语言×182.3K样本跨文化评估), MORE (ICML 2026, 多语言文档解析), WAXAL (Google, 27非洲语言×11000+小时语音), LEMAS (Idea研究院, 15万小时多语言语音), 万卷丝路2.0 (8语言×1150万条多模态SFT), malaysia-ai/Multilingual-TTS (10+语言TTS, 14.8K下载), MORPHOGEN (ACL 2026 Main, 性别形态生成), MUBENCH (ACL 2026, 61语言), IndicSafe + IndicGuard (印度语言安全), ToxiREX (6语言毒性推理), CAMEO8 (80K对话文化安全评估)。搜索渠道：HuggingFace Datasets API (10次搜索), DuckDuckGo web_search (5次搜索后限流), SearXNG (3次搜索), arXiv (1次后限流)。

sources.name: GaoYao Benchmark
sources.size: 182,300 samples across 9 cognitive sub-layers
sources.description: Comprehensive framework for evaluating multilingual and multicultural abilities of LLMs. Three-tier cultural evaluation framework (General Multilingual / Cross-cultural / Mono-cultural). Includes SuperBLEnD synthetic cross-cultural dataset. ACL 2026 Main Conference long paper.

sources.name: MORE: Multilingual Document Parsing Benchmark
sources.size: large-scale benchmark covering formulas, tables, code blocks, catalogs, reading order
sources.description: Large-scale benchmark for multilingual document parsing. Evaluates OCR and document parsing systems on recovering structured content (formulas, tables, code blocks, catalogs, reading order) across broad set of languages and scripts. Addresses evaluation blind spot for non-English/Chinese languages. ICML 2026.
sources.search_keywords: ICML 2026 multilingual document parsing OCR benchmark

sources.name: WAXAL (Google)
sources.size: 11,000+ hours of speech data for ASR and TTS, 27 Sub-Saharan African languages
sources.category: 预训练语料/低资源语言
sources.description: Google's large-scale open speech dataset for 27 Sub-Saharan African languages. Covers ASR and TTS tasks. Represents over 100 million speakers. Controlled by local institutions. Highest downloads (46,645) of any new African language dataset. 248 likes. Major milestone for African language AI.
sources.search_keywords: African language speech ASR TTS Google WAXAL

sources.name: malaysia-ai/Multilingual-TTS
sources.size: 14,841 downloads, 22 likes, large-scale TTS corpus
sources.description: High-quality multilingual TTS training dataset covering 10+ languages including Southeast Asian (Malay, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali) and European languages. Very active community usage (14.8K downloads). Updated July 12, 2026.

sources.name: LEMAS (Idea Research Institute)
sources.size: 150,000 hours multilingual speech data with word-level alignment
sources.description: Idea研究院开源的大规模多语言语音数据集(15万小时), 配套LEMAS-TTS和LEMAS-Edit两大生成模型。解决了多语言语音生成领域长期存在的高质量数据匮乏问题。严格的构建流程和精细的词级对齐。
sources.search_keywords: LEMAS 多语言语音数据集 Idea研究院

sources.name: 万卷·丝路2.0 (WanJuan Silk Road 2.0)
sources.size: 11,500,000+ items covering image-text, audio-text, video-text, SFT instruction data
sources.description: 全新升级的多语言多模态数据集，8个语种均提供图片-文本、音频-文本、视频-文本、特色指令微调SFT四大模态数据，覆盖多模态研究全链路。整体数据总量超过1150万条，音视频时长显著扩充。OpenDataLab平台发布。
sources.search_keywords: 万卷丝路 多语言多模态 SFT OpenDataLab

sources.name: MUBENCH
sources.size: 7,353 downloads, translated English benchmarks to 61 languages
sources.description: Assessment of multilingual capabilities of LLMs across 61 languages. Built by translating widely used English benchmarks. Reveals that models fall short of claimed multilingual coverage. ACL 2026 Findings. Proposes Multilingual alignment metrics.

sources.name: MORPHOGEN
sources.size: large-scale benchmark, 342 downloads on HuggingFace
sources.description: Multilingual benchmark for evaluating gender-aware morphological generation in LLMs. Morphologically grounded, large-scale. ACL 2026 Main Conference paper. Tests how well models handle gender inflection across typologically diverse languages.

sources.name: IndicGuard
sources.size: 198 downloads, high-volume culturally nuanced safety dataset for 10 Indic languages
sources.description: Multilingual safety guard model and dataset for 10 Indic languages. Captures regional harms, sensitive socio-political contexts, and adversarial jailbreaks. Fine-tuned 4B-parameter model (Gemma-3-4B-IT) for real-time content moderation. Outperforms CultureGuard baseline.

sources.name: IndicSafe
languages: 12 Indic languages (hi, bn, ta, te, kn, ml, mr, gu, pa, or, as, ur)
sources.size: 6,000 culturally grounded prompts spanning caste, religion, gender, health, politics
sources.description: First systematic evaluation of LLM safety across 12 Indic languages (1.2B+ speakers). Reveals significant safety drift: cross-language agreement is just 12.8%, SAFE rate variance exceeds 17%. Some models over-refuse benign prompts in low-resource scripts.
sources.search_keywords: Indic safety evaluation benchmark multilingual LLM

sources.name: CAMEO8
sources.size: 80,000 dialogs with cultural tags, 21,000 code-switching examples, 16,000 sentiment/emotion annotations, 8,000 safety-critical cases
sources.description: Multilingual prompt-and-dialogue dataset for evaluating and training culturally aware conversational AI. Covers cultural dialog, code-switching, sentiment/emotion, and bias/safety. IEEE DataPort release with implementation scripts and validation tools.
sources.search_keywords: CAMEO8 cultural dialog safety multilingual IEEE

sources.name: ToxiREX (Toxic REasoning in ConteXt)
sources.size: 125,000 LLM-annotated training comments + ~3,000 human-annotated test comments from Reddit
sources.description: Contextual multilingual dataset for toxic reasoning detection. Reddit comments with structured characterizations using systematic toxic reasoning schema. 6 languages, event-connected threads (Turkey earthquakes, Ukraine invasion). First dataset combining multiple languages, conversational context, and implicit toxicity.

sources.name: BiasedTales-ML
sources.size: ~350,000 children's stories generated across 8 languages
sources.description: Large-scale parallel corpus of children's stories for analyzing narrative attribute distributions in LLM-generated content. Full-permutation prompting design. Proposes structured generator-extractor pipeline and multi-dimensional distributional analysis. Interactive visualization tool included.

sources.name: RuSafety
sources.size: 1,198 dangerous Russian prompts covering 14 safety scenarios
sources.description: Curated Russian-language safety evaluation dataset derived from XSafety benchmark via multi-stage filtering and validation. Evaluates YandexGPT Lite/Pro, GPT-OSS-20B/120B. Reveals different alignment strategies despite similar safety rates. Uses Qwen3-235B as LLM-as-Judge.

sources.name: GlobalHealthAtlas
sources.size: 280,210 instances spanning 15 public health domains
sources.description: Large-scale multilingual dataset for public health reasoning. LLM-assisted construction with retrieval, deduplication, evidence grounding checks, and label validation. Domain-aligned evaluator assessing Accuracy, Reasoning, Completeness, Consensus Alignment, Terminology Norms, and Insightfulness.

sources.name: Thiomi Dataset
sources.size: 601,000+ sentence-level text annotations + 385,000+ audio recordings
sources.category: 预训练语料/低资源语言
sources.description: Large-scale multimodal corpus for 10 African languages across 4 language families (East Africa: Swahili, Kikuyu, Kamba, Kimeru, Luo, Maasai, Kipsigis, Somali; West Africa: Wolof; West/Central: Fulani). Dedicated collection platform. Supports ASR, MT, TTS.

sources.name: LingualX64
sources.size: 126 translation directions (XX→en, XX→zh)
sources.description: Multilingual benchmark for evaluating symmetry and consistency in LLM translation. 64 languages, 126 translation directions. Reveals persistent asymmetries despite improved performance. Published in Nature Scientific Reports.

sources.name: multilingual-vlm-conflict (VLM Conflict Datasets)
sources.size: Multiple sub-datasets (1K-10K each): pendulum, worldcuisines, coco-counterfactual, sea-vl, rpg, physics, radiology, 3D-Object, code, DrivingVQA
sources.description: Comprehensive suite of visual-language model conflict/consistency evaluation datasets. Covers physics, radiology, code, 3D objects, driving, RPG, world cuisines, and more. Multilingual evaluation across 10+ languages. Updated July 2026.

sources.name: FBK-MT/RedVox
sources.size: 1K-10K samples, speech safety and fairness benchmark
sources.description: Multilingual safety and fairness benchmark for speech and audio models. Built on real voices covering unsafe and biased content across 5 European languages. Only 8% of SOTA speech models document multilingual safety analysis.

sources.name: Debk/Indian-Multilingual-Bias-Dataset
sources.size: 1K-10K samples for bias detection
sources.description: Multilingual bias detection dataset covering English, Bengali, and Hindi. Tasks include fact-checking and semantic similarity scoring. Designed for text classification and fill-mask bias evaluation.

sources.name: ghananlpcommunity/twi-llm-reasoning-dataset-1k
sources.size: <1K samples, reasoning/QA dataset
sources.description: Twi language (Ghana) LLM reasoning dataset. One of very few reasoning benchmarks for Twi/Akan, an important West African language spoken by 11M+ people. Community-driven by GhanaNLP.
sources.search_keywords: Twi Akan reasoning low-resource African language

sources.name: Nemotron-Personas Regional Variants (India + Korea)
sources.size: 1M-10M samples each, image+text modalities
sources.description: Regional persona variants of NVIDIA's Nemotron-Personas dataset. India variant covers English+Hindi with Indian cultural personas. Korea variant covers Korean personas. Both 1M-10M scale with image+text modalities. Community-created derivatives.

sources.name: nvidia/Nemotron-CC-v2 (版本更新)
sources.size: 21,788 downloads, large-scale pretraining corpus
sources.description: NVIDIA's multilingual pretraining corpus v2. Updated 2026-07-07 (within current window). Already tracked in previous incremental (2026-07-11). Version update: new data additions or corrections since last tracked.
